description: This file defines a ProducerProcessor class for filtering, transforming, and distributing frames in a processing pipeline, including methods for adding consumers and processing frames asynchronously.

classes.name: ProducerProcessor
classes.description: A processor that filters frames and distributes them to multiple consumers, with optional transformation and passthrough capabilities.

methods.name: add_consumer
methods.description: Adds a new consumer queue and returns it.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame, applies filter and transformer, and manages distribution and passthrough.

methods.name: _produce
methods.description: Produces a transformed frame to all registered consumer queues.
